data.one_liner: Pre-built widgets and utilities for integrating Firebase Firestore into Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built widgets and utility components designed to make it easier to bind Firebase Firestore queries and collections directly to your Flutter user interface.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app backed by Cloud Firestore
You want to quickly render lists or tables from Firestore queries without writing custom pagination and stream logic
avoid_when: Your app does not use Firebase Firestore
You require fully customized UI components that share no design patterns with standard Firebase UI
strengths: Reduces boilerplate for common Firestore UI patterns
Includes query builder and data table widgets out of the box
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to Firebase Firestore and ecosystem packages
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase in your Flutter app and importing the necessary dependencies.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer handling data streams and building custom widgets from scratch without pre-built UI components.
